title: Change the manager details on a vehicle registration
summary: This page explains how to add, change, or delete the manager details for a vehicle or fleet of vehicles registration.
intro:
If the registration of a vehicle or fleet of vehicles has been assigned to a manager, mail relating to the registration, such as renewals, billing information, will be sent to that manager.

To add, change the details of, or delete a manager please visit a Service NSW Centre. Alternatively, you can call us on 13 77 88.
